slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Onsager's exact spontaneous magnetization curve, reproduced within 5% on a 128 by 128 lattice, with a susceptibility peak near T of 2.27.
A blind viewer test of at least 15 people comparing the piece to a boids-only control, with free-text descriptions coded by two blind coders.
